_why: ADR 0013's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
This table had never been checked by anything. It was invisible to
guard anchored its matcher at `^|` and this ADR indents its table inside
a bullet (ADR 0144). Written 2026-07, unverified for a month, and it was
a fix to the GUARD -- not to this ADR -- that surfaced it.
The decision it records is load-bearing for the whole kinetics path:
Vmax = kcat x [E]0 is what makes a literature kcat simulable, and ADR
0142 built the lab report's `derived` origin on top of it.

NOTE ON THE TEST COMMAND: `-q` is deliberately absent. caterva/pytest.ini suppresses the summary line under -q, so the harness could not count tests and refused to run -- correctly reporting that every verdict would be meaningless rather than guessing. That refusal is the harness working: a silent `0 total` read as `0 failed` is one of the three ways hand-run mutations were wrong before ADR 0069.
test: cd caterva && python3 -m pytest tests/test_vmax_from_kcat.py --no-header -p no:cacheprovider

mutations._note: The bridge itself. Addition is dimensionally meaningless -- 1/s plus mM -- and still returns a plausible-looking positive float, which is why a test that only checked 'a number came back' would pass.

mutations.description: the [E]0 << Km ratio check is disabled
mutations._note: Past this ratio the ES complex holds a non-negligible share of substrate and the curve is quantitatively wrong (the tight-binding regime this engine does not implement). Disabling the check does not change any number -- it removes the warning that the number is being stretched.

mutations.description: a zero enzyme concentration is allowed through
mutations._claimed: caught by the zero-enzyme rejection test
mutations._note: [E]0 = 0 gives Vmax = 0: a model that provably cannot turn over. validate_michaelis_menten_params rejects it later, so catching it here is what names the real cause instead of reporting a downstream symptom.

mutations.description: the flag is collapsed into a rejection
mutations._note: The one ADR 0013 says matters most: the constitution names this violation explicitly -- 'do not collapse this distinction in either direction'. A stretched approximation still runs and still teaches something; refusing it and rejecting it are different answers to the student. The bare `v.flagged = True` occurs three times in this file, so the first spec was INDETERMINATE -- the harness refused to say which site it had changed rather than pick one. Extended with the flag_reason that is unique to the [E]0/Km ratio.
mutations.find:
v.flagged = True
            v.flag_reason = (
                f"[E]0 {enzyme_conc:g} mM is {ratio:.3g}x Km ({km:g} mM); the "
mutations.replace:
v.ok = False
            v.flag_reason = (
                f"[E]0 {enzyme_conc:g} mM is {ratio:.3g}x Km ({km:g} mM); the "
